Great video for those in their 30's 
If I had $250k (and let me add the obligatory disclaimer the pro's use) "of which I were to lose would not affect my way of life" I would go for the max:
AMDW = $136K/year
DRMY = $109Kyear
ZVOL = $190K/year
Screw $48K/year, especially if you're in or near retirement. You know your portfolio, you know how much you can gamble with.
$250,000 right into chpy then
Yes, decisions should most likely be based on age. You can have all the money in the world, but it will do you no good when you are in the nursing home or in the ground.

I missed a calculation of the age in each line after reaching the goal of 4000$/month. 
Taking in account that life spam in USA is 80 y/o.
Line A reaches the gol at 72 y/o, 8 years left. Dont need to calculate what happens after 10 years, you  are dead (statistically speaking)

Line C reaches the goal at 57, still 23 years left

You are terrible at this. You get the outcome by design. You assume the crash happens the day you deposit the full amount and that the cover call doesn't out grow inflation. these are not real world examples of index cover call etf. Plus a Canadian etf will do the cover calls on leverage and mostly keep pace with the underlaying index. There are a lot of examples where the out come works. You just chose to design in failure
I think, XYLD is not the best covered call etf. There are a lot better funds, witch do not erode NAV.
Too much fluff. Please get to the meat of this video
I rather find it quite comprehensive
We don’t need a half hour for 4 minutes of an explanation.
